## MotionKraft Release

### Install
1. Download `app-release.apk`
2. On your Android device, allow installation from unknown sources when prompted
3. Verify the SHA256 checksum matches `sha256sums.txt`

### Notes
- Minimum Android: 7.0 (API 24)
- Architecture: arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a
- Signed with official MotionKraft release key
